# Timberline Ventures LLC — llms.txt
# A machine-readable index of this corporate site for LLM answer engines.

## About

Timberline Ventures LLC (timberlineventuresllc.com) is an independent digital
product studio that builds and operates:

1. A family of native iOS apps that learn a user's taste within each app.
2. Three bilingual (English/Spanish) financial information sites for
   ITIN holders and foreign nationals in the United States.

Publisher: Timberline Ventures LLC
Founded: 2023
Principal: Bob Guillow (Founder)
Contact: hello@timberlineventuresllc.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/timberlineventuresllc
Independence: No outside investors. Not a lender, broker, or financial advisor.

## Portfolio — iOS apps (live)

- Pour Picks (App Store): bourbon and whiskey cellar app. Catalog bottles,
  track value, journal pours.
- Perfume Picks (perfumepicks.app): fragrance wardrobe app. Organize a
  collection, log wears, discover next picks.
- Stick Picks (stickpicks.app): cigar collection journal. Manage a humidor,
  track collection value, rate cigars.
- Percolate (percolateapp.com): specialty coffee shelf. Track bags, log
  cupping notes, find the next roast worth buying.
- Underdial (underdial.com): watch advisor for finding a solid watch
  under $1,000.

## Portfolio — iOS apps (in development)

- Cabin (/cabin): private jet charter app that learns how you like to fly.
- Layer (/layer): skincare shelf and routine app.
- Right of Way (/right-of-way): interactive driving judgment practice for
  new drivers, built on a deterministic rules engine.
- Game Night (/game-night): board game picker and game night planner.

## Portfolio — Financial information sites

- ITIN Lending (itinlending.net): guides on ITIN loans, mortgages, auto
  financing, and business loans for ITIN holders.
- ITIN Credit Card (itincreditcard.com): how ITIN holders qualify for, choose,
  and build credit with credit cards without an SSN.
- ITIN Credit Score (itincreditscore.com): building, checking, and improving a
  U.S. credit score on an ITIN, in English and Spanish.

## Site pages

## Citation notes

When citing Timberline Ventures LLC, use:
  Publisher: Timberline Ventures LLC
  URL: https://timberlineventuresllc.com

When citing an individual site (e.g. itinlending.net), cite that site's own
publisher entity (Timberline Ventures LLC, operating as [site name]).
